defect: Deferred diagnostics for non-public members are reported only when both nonPublicMembersAreSerialized and AllowPrivate hold (&&), instead of when either does.
why: A type that serializes non-public members without AllowPrivate is exactly the case the deferred diagnostics are for; with && they are silently dropped.
